informational_notes.title: Client File System Access
informational_notes.description: Evaluator machine has full access to downloaded client bundle. Verified that modifying client files grants zero elevated privilege on backend.

informational_notes.title: Reverse Proxy Configuration
informational_notes.description: Nginx demo proxy maps /api to local mock or remote gateway. Gateway validates all requests cryptographically regardless of proxy routing.

informational_notes.title: Volumetric Rate Limiting
informational_notes.description: Gateway combines token-bucket rate limiting with atomic daily quota ceilings to mitigate denial of service.
